library.rt_200:r_f90c529773d5c0fc.text:
A mass-production Space Gunmen operated by the Dai-Gurren Brigade.
It is a mass-produced Lazengann-type unit, discovered stored inside Cathedral Lazengann, and came to be piloted mainly by soldiers of the New Government forces.
$$ギミー$$'s unit has distinctive accent coloring in several places, and a head shape that differs from the standard model.

library.rt_200:r_344b999e99fce9aa.text:

It is a mass-produced Lazengann-type unit, discovered stored inside Cathedral Lazengann, and came to be piloted mainly by soldiers of the New Government forces.

library.rt_200:r_52f25e9d583892b3.text:
The Space Gunmen piloted by $$キタン$$.
It keeps its trademark nasty glare, but now has a face on the back as well as the front.
It carries armor thicker than that of other Gunmen, and with the added acceleration from boosters mounted on its head and crotch, it boasts breakthrough power that matches its sharp, angular body.

library.rt_200:r_d659ae4c47f9bdec.text:
The Space Gunmen piloted by $$キタン$$.
It keeps its trademark nasty glare, but now has a face on the back as well as the front.
It carries armor thicker than that of other Gunmen, and with the added acceleration from boosters mounted on its head and crotch, it boasts breakthrough power that matches its sharp, angular body.
Within the intense gravity field inside the Galactic Spiral Trench, it becomes a heavily-equipped form that puts its original speed to use, breaking through enemy lines at high velocity. Though its outer armor was ultimately destroyed, the King $$キタン$$ inside, burning $$キタン$$'s own life force, unleashed a Giga Drill Break that pierced the Death Spiral Machine and saved $$シモン$$ and the others.

library.rt_200:r_ae2cd11c2a0090ad.text:
$$ヨーコ$$'s personal Space Gunmen.
Its coloring and overall silhouette resemble the $$ヨーコ$$ M-Tank, but its gun turret has been doubled, and missile pods have been added to the arms to boost firepower. Its legs are also fitted with rocket engines called Geta Boosters, and its overall performance has been dramatically improved.
Note that every Space Gunmen shares a matryoshka-doll-like structure, in which a normal Gunmen climbs inside to pilot it.

library.rt_200:r_0867c3309659e557.text:
The low-grade type of the weapon that serves as the Anti-Spirals' vanguard.
Its molecular structure is unstable; when destroyed, it breaks apart into blocks that then explode individually.
It appeared in $$カミナ$$ City the moment the Human Extermination System was activated.
Unlike Gunmen, it had no face, and from then on it came to be called $$ムガン$$, meaning 'faceless'.

library.rt_200:r_b28d68ba1590745b.text:
The high-grade type of the weapon that serves as the Anti-Spirals' vanguard.
Its molecular structure is unstable; when destroyed, it breaks apart into blocks that then explode individually.
The high-grade type forms the core of a $$ムガン$$ unit, suspending low-grade types from its hangar-shaped lower body. Beam-like tentacles extend from those low-grade types and link up to further low-grade types, forming a single formation of up to 32 units in stacks of 8 by 4.

library.rt_200:r_df16e85fa9863eff.text:
The mothership of the Anti-Spiral fleet. Its formal name is 'Multiversal Evolutionary Probability Life-form Anti-Spiral Assault Vessel'.
It possesses capabilities beyond human comprehension, including the Random Schrodinger Warp, which controls multidimensional probability to move within the timeline, and attacks that use satellite missiles and probability-fluctuation shells.
Note that 'Ashtanga' means 'eight limbs' in Sanskrit.

library.rt_200:r_925e934a0ef2b316.text:
A super-dreadnought-class space battleship of the Anti-Spiral fleet, commonly known as the 'Buddha Hand'.
It is roughly the same size as Arc-Gurren, and uses its enormous body, itself a hand, to crush, pin down, or charge forward as a fist: simple but powerful attacks.
Note that 'Hastagurai' means 'palm' in Sanskrit.

library.rt_200:r_6dd3d3bb3f00b3fe.text:
A super-dreadnought-class space battleship of the Anti-Spiral fleet, commonly known as the 'Buddha Foot'.
It fires beams from the multiple launch ports on the sole of its foot.
Note that 'Pada' means 'path' or 'foot' in Sanskrit.

library.rt_200:r_2d281d6864c71aac.text:
A being given physical form by the Anti-Spirals, one that can be called the Anti-Spirals themselves.
It appeared to intercept $$シモン$$ and the others when they entered the sealed-off universe, and its size far exceeds that of a galaxy.
To instill absolute despair in $$シモン$$ and the others by 'fighting them on equal terms and winning,' it appeared as a counterpart to Tengen Toppa $$グレンラガン$$, and possesses power that even surpasses Tengen Toppa $$グレンラガン$$'s own.
Its name means 'the ultimate cosmic demon god that seeks to destroy $$グレンラガン$$ through absolute despair,' a name later given to it by $$ロシウ$$.

library.rt_200:r_c9c28794560096e4.text:
A being given physical form by the Anti-Spirals, one that can be called the Anti-Spirals themselves.
It appeared to intercept $$シモン$$ and the others when they entered the sealed-off universe, and its size far exceeds that of a galaxy.
On its forehead sits the home world the Anti-Spirals had, back when they still possessed physical bodies.
To instill absolute despair in $$シモン$$ and the others by 'fighting them on equal terms and winning,' it appeared as a counterpart to Tengen Toppa $$グレンラガン$$, and possesses power that even surpasses Tengen Toppa $$グレンラガン$$'s own.
When the Anti-Spirals met their end, it vanished in response.
Its name means 'the ultimate cosmic demon god that seeks to destroy $$グレンラガン$$ through absolute despair,' a name later given to it by $$ロシウ$$.

library.rt_200:r_270dc537fe40c607.text:
The $$汎用ヒト型決戦兵器　人造人間エヴァンゲリオン　試験初号機$$.
The EVA series is humanity's only weapon capable of opposing the Angels, and the special agency NERV is pouring vast sums of money into its development and construction.
Its greatest characteristic is its ability to deploy an A.T. Field.
Its main power is electricity supplied through the umbilical cable on its back. If the cable is severed, it switches to its internal power source, but reaches its activity limit within five minutes.
Unit-01's main armaments include the Progressive Knife for close combat, a large-caliber 209mm rifle, and a portable rotary multi-barrel 440mm cannon.

library.rt_200:r_8579c398570ecfbd.text:
The $$汎用ヒト型決戦兵器　人造人間エヴァンゲリオン　試験初号機$$.
The EVA series is humanity's only weapon capable of opposing the Angels, and NERV branches around the world are pouring vast sums of money into its development and construction.
Its greatest characteristic is its ability to deploy an A.T. Field. 'A.T.' stands for 'Absolute Terror,' referring to the absolute territory the Angels deploy. By having the same ability, an EVA can erode its opponent's field, making it possible for the first time to attack the core and other weak points.
Its main power is electricity supplied through the umbilical cable on its back. If the cable is severed, it switches to its internal power source, but reaches its activity limit within five minutes.
Unit-01's main armaments include the Progressive Knife for close combat, a large-caliber 209mm rifle, and a portable rotary multi-barrel 440mm cannon.
In the battle against $$第４の使徒$$, Unit-01 became completely uncontrollable, but restarted and went berserk, annihilating the Angel with overwhelming power.
As this shows, much about the EVA series remains unknown, and little information about it has been made public.

library.rt_200:r_4e271c7cfac7c6d8.text:
EVA Unit-01 in its berserk state.
Berserk refers to the mysterious behavior observed in Unit-01.
In the battle against $$第４の使徒$$, Unit-01 took massive damage and fell out of control. But then, independent of $$シンジ$$'s will, it restarted, let out a roar, and struck back at the Angel. In the end, even after being caught in the Angel's self-destruct attack, it emerged unharmed, shaking the NERV headquarters staff to their core.

library.rt_200:r_df2441e5fd1c9390.text:

library.rt_200:r_233413d64a87f725.text:
The $$汎用ヒト型決戦兵器　人造人間エヴァンゲリオン　試作零号機$$.

In the battle against $$第６の使徒$$, it was equipped with the dedicated single-unit defense armament 'Enchanted Shield of Virtue,' and used it to protect Unit-01 from the Angel's beam cannon attacks.

library.rt_200:r_1d6eea4e51c81aac.text:
The fourth Angel to attack Tokyo-3.
It moves on two legs. Its main attack is a spear of light fired from its palm.
The United Nations Forces' attacks could not stop its advance, and even an N2 mine, their trump card, only managed to slow it down.
It fought $$シンジ$$, who boarded EVA Unit-01 without understanding the situation.

library.rt_200:r_eabd4c855c146340.text:
The fourth Angel to attack Tokyo-3.
It moves on two legs. Its main attack is a spear of light fired from its palm.
The United Nations Forces' attacks could not stop its advance, and even an N2 mine, their trump card, only managed to slow it down.
It engaged $$シンジ$$, who boarded EVA Unit-01 without understanding the situation, landing blow after blow and driving it out of action. But Unit-01 restarted and went berserk; when its counterattack threatened to destroy the Angel's core, it self-destructed, taking Unit-01 with it. Even so, it failed to defeat Unit-01.

library.rt_200:r_6ac16dd1b88d8837.text:
The fifth Angel to attack Tokyo-3.
It moves mainly by flying, and slices through anything with the two whips of light on its left and right.
It withstood a furious barrage from EVA Unit-01's portable rotary multi-barrel 440mm cannon with barely a scratch, and instead overwhelmed Unit-01.

library.rt_200:r_c5ac17bc7a26b38b.text:
The fifth Angel to attack Tokyo-3.
It moves mainly by flying, and slices through anything with the two whips of light on its left and right.
It withstood a furious barrage from EVA Unit-01's portable rotary multi-barrel 440mm cannon with barely a scratch, and instead overwhelmed Unit-01. In the end, as Unit-01's activity limit drew near, it took a counterattack and was defeated when the Progressive Knife was driven into its core.

library.rt_200:r_6fa61627aca9fc20.text:
The sixth Angel to attack Tokyo-3.
It is characterized by its ability to shift from a regular octahedron into a variety of forms. It automatically eliminates any hostile that comes within a certain distance, using a powerful beam cannon.
It advanced on Tokyo-3 from Lake Ashi, driving off Unit-01 when it sortied to intercept. It then aimed to attack NERV headquarters directly from directly above. According to calculations by MAGI, NERV's computer system, piercing its A.T. Field would require enough N2 aerial depth charges to destroy the headquarters along with it.

The General-Purpose Humanoid Decisive Battle Weapon, Artificial Human Evangelion, Production Model Unit-02.
Its assigned pilot is $$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$. Its main color is red.
Unlike Unit-00 and Unit-01, which were a prototype and a test type from the development process, it is the world's first official production type built for actual combat. $$アスカ$$ calls it 'a real Evangelion'.

library.rt_200:r_038ef8d709aa84a8.text:

It infiltrated EVA Unit-03, which was undergoing testing at Matsushiro, eroding it from within and possessing it. This caused a massive explosion that collapsed the temporary cage and ground control facility. library.rt_200:r_2beea265d14ed938.text:
The ninth Angel to appear.
It infiltrated EVA Unit-03, which was undergoing testing at Matsushiro, eroding it from within and possessing it. This caused a massive explosion that collapsed the temporary cage and ground control facility. At first it could not be identified as an Angel because its analysis pattern showed orange, but since it ignored the stop signal and the entry plug ejection code, $$ゲンドウ$$ ultimately designated it $$第９の使徒$$.
In the battle against EVA Unit-01, it broke free of its restraints and attacked with four arms, attempting to infect it. But Unit-01, having switched over to the Dummy System, struck back, and in the end had its core, which had been infecting the entry plug, crushed between its teeth, annihilating it.

library.rt_200:r_72e06ef95f3afad5.text:
Zero's personal KMF.
Equipped with a variable mechanism, it can transform into Fortress Mode, and is capable not only of high-speed flight but also underwater travel.
Though it is derived from a Black Knights unit, repurposing Gawain's Druid System gives it remarkable processing power. To make optimal use of Absolute Defense Field, the powerful defensive field said to offer the best protection in the world, its surroundings must be fed into the Druid System instantly and accurately.
Its chest is also equipped with a diffusion-structure phase-transition cannon: it fires solid liquid metal, then irradiates that metal with a particle beam, scattering the particles across a wide area.
Making full use of these two distinctive offensive and defensive systems requires a level of information processing ability high enough to draw out the full power of the Druid System. For this reason, it is said that anyone other than $$ルルーシュ$$ can pilot it, but cannot bring out its full performance.
Perhaps because a touch-panel keyboard is used for its calculations, the cockpit interior is not the motorcycle-style design $$ラクシャータ$$ favors, but closer to the Britannian style seen in Gawain.
It was also designed with long-distance travel in mind, so its cockpit is roomier than that of other KMFs, and can even store things like Zero's mask and costume.

In the end, it was destroyed inside Damocles by $$ジノ$$'s Tristan Divider.

library.rt_200:r_e416d0b440e422d4.text:
The Guren, after being captured in the fighting with the Chinese Federation and handed over to Britannia, then completely rebuilt by Lloyd and Cecile.
According to Lloyd, it was easy to tinker with because it was originally one of $$ラクシャータ$$'s machines; before either of them realized it, their hobbyist enthusiasm took over completely, and together they built a high-performance unit that almost no one could fully handle.
It was thought that no one but $$スザク$$ could master it, but $$カレン$$, rescued by $$咲世子$$, took the controls. At just 60% output, she overwhelmed the Lancelot Conquista. Its performance is equivalent to a Ninth Generation KMF, and on paper it even surpasses the other Ninth Generation KMF, the $$ランスロット・アルビオン$$.
In place of its flight glide wings, it is equipped with Energy Wings. Those wings can cover its entire body, allowing high-speed flight while maintaining a defensive stance.
Its armor-piercing right-arm cannon was also improved; it can be launched like a Slash Harken, and by controlling its trajectory with a wire, it can deliver a Radiant Wave Surger to distant opponents as well. It can also throw the Radiant Wave Surger in disc form.
The name Seiten Hakkyoku comes from the text $$咲世子$$ saw displayed on the startup screen during its first sortie, 'Superlative Extruder Interlocked Technology Exclusive Nexus EIGHT ELEMENTS,' rendered into Japanese.
In the final battle, it fought a death match against $$スザク$$'s $$ランスロット・アルビオン$$, their strength evenly matched. In the end, the two dealt each other a mutual finishing blow, but the Guren's fist destroyed the $$ランスロット・アルビオン$$'s cockpit. The Albion exploded, and the fated duel came to a close with victory for $$カレン$$ and the Guren.

library.rt_200:r_d2f39158f1659778.text:
A unit developed at Camelot as $$スザク$$'s personal machine.
Along with the previously developed $$紅蓮聖天八極式$$, it is a Ninth Generation KMF; since only these two machines exist at that generation, it overwhelmed every other unit in every respect.
Its greatest feature is the dramatic boost to its mobility and agility from being equipped with Energy Wings. The Energy Wings can also be used offensively, releasing blade-like energy, or defensively, covering the unit's body the way Blaze Ruuminous does.
Combining its outstanding performance with $$スザク$$'s own skill, it could smash even a Knight of the Round's personal machine in a single blow. As a symbol of $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$'s power, it became an object of fear and hatred across the entire world.
In the final battle, it refused to yield an inch against ace machines like Todoh's Zangetsu and $$星刻$$'s Shen Hu, buying time until the FLEIJA Eliminator was complete, then, in the mere 0.04 seconds available, hurled the FLEIJA Eliminator to stop the FLEIJA's detonation.
After entering Damocles, it faced its old rival $$カレン$$. Both fought with everything they had, and the battle ended in mutual destruction: it took the fist of the $$紅蓮聖天八極式$$ to its cockpit and exploded.

library.rt_200:r_2c45e7c0b5e45423.text:
A KMF assembled by Lloyd and Cecile from spare Lancelot parts, for $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ to pilot.
Its armaments are the same as the original Lancelot's; the main differences are its coloring, the addition of Percival's missile shield, and the addition of an escape mechanism.

library.rt_200:r_5fb08c6bcbfd3205.text:
A KMF assembled by Lloyd and Cecile from spare Lancelot parts, for $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ to pilot.
Its armaments are the same as the original Lancelot's; the main differences are its coloring, the addition of Percival's missile shield, and the addition of an escape mechanism.
In the final battle it fought $$カレン$$'s $$紅蓮聖天八極式$$. It managed to buy just enough time for $$ルルーシュ$$ to escape, but the overwhelming gap in both machine performance and pilot skill left it utterly outmatched, and it was shot down.

library.rt_200:r_f6dc0f72286776ee.text:
A Mechanical Angel owned by Neo-DEAVA.
It is completed when three fighter craft called Vector Machines combine.
Depending on the combination, it can form three different configurations, each with a greatly different fighting style and appearance.
Its pilots are boys and girls with superhuman abilities called Element users. Their power is required for the combination, and the combined unit's specs are also heavily affected by their abilities and mental state.
In Aquarion EVOL, Vector Zed forms the upper body, Vector X the lower body, and Vector Siron the back.
This form is easily influenced by its pilots' Element abilities, but of the three configurations it can produce the greatest power.
It closely resembles the Mythical Aquarion of the legend from 12,000 years ago, sharing common points such as a red-based color scheme and Solar Wings mounted on its back.
It had been sealed away because male-female combination was forbidden, but it awakened when $$アマタ$$ and $$ミコノ$$ boarded it.

library.rt_200:r_072d34f346d4d7db.text:

library.rt_200:r_161d39e726f9eb53.text:
A Mechanical Angel owned by Neo-DEAVA.
It is completed when three fighter craft called Vector Machines combine.
Depending on the combination, it can form three different configurations, each with a greatly different fighting style and appearance.
Its pilots are boys and girls with superhuman abilities called Element users. Their power is required for the combination, and the combined unit's specs are also heavily affected by their abilities and mental state.
In $$アクエリオンゲパルト$$, Vector X forms the upper body, Vector Siron the lower body, and Vector Zed the back.
It is equipped with a large volume of heavy weaponry and excels at mid-to-long-range combat on the ground. It is also the most heavily armored of all its configurations.
Compared to its other configurations, Gepard can be formed and operated with less Element ability, placing less strain on its pilots. For this reason, it was also considered the prototype for the Aquaria M-Type and F-Type, which combine separately by gender.
It is mainly piloted by $$カイエン$$ and $$ゼシカ$$, but because it does not select for a particular pilot, many cadets have piloted it.

library.rt_200:r_0af45d9c27318c42.text:
A Mechanical Angel owned by Neo-DEAVA.
It is completed when three fighter craft called Vector Machines combine.
Depending on the combination, it can form three different configurations, each with a greatly different fighting style and appearance.
Its pilots are boys and girls with superhuman abilities called Element users. Their power is required for the combination, and the combined unit's specs are also heavily affected by their abilities and mental state.
In $$アクエリオンスパーダ$$, Vector Siron forms the upper body, Vector Zed the lower body, and Vector X the back.
It comes standard with an Energy Sword in its right hand and a shield in its left.
It boasts a movement speed that exceeds the speed of sound, and excels at high-speed combat that makes use of that speed.
Operating it requires high Element ability, as well as the skill to fully handle a high-speed unit, making it the configuration that demands the most from its pilot's own ability.
It is mainly piloted by $$シュレード$$.

It is mainly piloted by $$シュレード$$.
In the final battle, $$カイエン$$ piloted it. Sensing the melody of the soul that $$シュレード$$ had left behind, he brought forth a new configuration, Aquarion Geparda, and fought $$ミカゲ$$.

library.rt_200:r_b9d802b53fd12907.text:
A mid-size, mass-produced, multipurpose Mythical Beast.
It is a spider-shaped, self-piloting drone, though it can also be remote-controlled. It is also equipped with a cockpit, allowing manned piloting when necessary.
This type is a combat model, but many other variants exist, the abduction model being a representative example.
It flies freely using a gravity-control engine, and moves on the ground using its four legs.

library.rt_200:r_a97ea32a05e64563.text:
A mid-size, mass-produced, multipurpose Mythical Beast.
It is a spider-shaped, self-piloting drone, though it can also be remote-controlled. It is also equipped with a cockpit, allowing manned piloting when necessary.
This type is a combat model, but many other variants exist, the abduction model being a representative example.
It flies freely using a gravity-control engine, and moves on the ground using its four legs.
On Altair it is a machine produced in large numbers and nothing special, but to an Earth lagging behind in science and weapons technology, it poses a considerable threat.

library.rt_200:r_83623f414e3c26f9.text:
A humanoid Abductor built for combat.
It is normally designed to move through the air under gravity control while fighting. It can walk on the ground, but its mobility in ground combat is not high.
Manual piloting by a person on board is possible, but it is mostly operated by remote control.
Various specialized personal units have been built using this machine as a base.

library.rt_200:r_9a3cc5e8e2d13157.text:
A humanoid Abductor customized specifically for $$カグラ$$.
It is painted in a red-based personal color.
It excels at aerial combat using the wings on its back, but it can also transform into a four-legged walking mode that reflects $$カグラ$$'s wild personality, enabling high-speed combat on the ground as well.
$$カグラ$$, targeting $$ミコノ$$, used it to attack Neo-DEAVA time and again, driving Aquarion and $$アマタ$$ into desperate situations.

library.rt_200:r_23652850c9556afe.text:
A humanoid Abductor customized specifically for $$カグラ$$.
It is painted in a red-based personal color.
Its name means 'winged lion' in the language of Altair, and true to its name, it excels at aerial combat using the wings on its back.
It can also transform into a four-legged walking mode that reflects $$カグラ$$'s wild personality. This makes high-speed combat possible on the ground as well.
$$カグラ$$, targeting $$ミコノ$$, used it to attack Neo-DEAVA time and again, driving Aquarion and $$アマタ$$ into desperate situations.

library.rt_200:r_c73120b0774da918.text:
A humanoid Abductor customized specifically for $$ジン$$.
It is equipped with gear specialized for long-range combat, such as a custom gun and a high-output beam cannon.
It comes standard with numerous built-in Reflection Balls for omnidirectional fire support, allowing it to attack from any angle while keeping its distance from the enemy.
It can also analyze combat data to swap out its armaments and change its fighting style. $$ジン$$ analyzed Aquarion's data and fought it while changing his armaments several times.

library.rt_200:r_a77e6444c7e8f352.text:
A humanoid Abductor exclusive to $$イズモ$$.
As the personal machine of Altair's supreme commander, it is characterized by an elegant design resembling a cape topped with a crown.
It is far more heavily armored than other Abductors, sturdy enough to withstand even Aquarion's finishing attacks without a scratch.
The cape-shaped armor on both shoulders can reflect any attack, whether beam weapon or solid round, back at the attacker doubled in force.

library.rt_200:r_63dbb70610c1d3b5.text:
A humanoid Abductor customized specifically for $$イズモ$$.
As the personal machine of Altair's supreme commander, it is characterized by an elegant design resembling a cape topped with a crown.
It is far more heavily armored than other Gnis, sturdy enough to withstand even Aquarion's finishing attacks without a scratch.
The cape-shaped armor on both shoulders can reflect any attack, whether beam weapon or solid round, back at the attacker doubled in force.
Furthermore, if the battle takes place on Altair, it can also unleash its finishing attack, the Home World Total War Cannon, powered by Iron-C energy.
Combined with $$イズモ$$'s own skill, it boasts overwhelming combat power strong enough to put even the Mythical Aquarion through a hard fight.

library.rt_200:r_fd71c575e3ef69d8.text:
A humanoid Abductor piloted by $$ＭＩＸＹ$$.
It is painted in $$ＭＩＸＹ$$'s personal color, orange.
Aside from carrying a large-caliber rifle, it shows no major differences from a standard Abductor.
However, it has the ability to amplify its pilot $$ＭＩＸＹ$$'s Element ability, 'Spatial Compensation,' giving it greater combat power than an ordinary unit.

library.rt_200:r_697ea45b85455910.text:
A humanoid Abductor piloted by $$ＭＩＸ$$, who was abducted by Altair and transformed into a male.
It is painted in $$ＭＩＸＹ$$'s personal color, orange.
Aside from carrying a large-caliber rifle, it shows no major differences from a standard Gnis.
However, it has the ability to amplify its pilot $$ＭＩＸＹ$$'s Element ability, 'Spatial Compensation,' giving it greater combat power than an ordinary unit.

library.rt_200:r_faf14976e0db1b74.text:
A humanoid weapon sent by $$ミカゲ$$.
It is highly agile, toying with its enemies through unpredictable movement.
It is characterized by long limbs and sharp claws, and can summon a blizzard.
